title: Thai green curry with prawns and vegetables
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
For a green paste, blend the curry paste with the spinach and 2 tbsp coconut milk until smooth.
Toast the paste in a pot for 1 minute, add the remaining coconut milk and stock and bring to the boil.
Simmer the beans, courgette and pepper in it for 5 minutes, add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice, fold in the basil and serve with rice.
